data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts a SUBSTANTIVE integration relation (resilience depends on matching the failure's causal nature—stochastic vs systemic—to the structural defense—redundancy vs heterogeneity), but it provides no causal mechanism explaining WHY stochastic failures require redundancy rather than heterogeneity or why systemic failures require heterogeneity rather than redundancy. Without specifying the operative mechanism (e.g., redundancy mitigates stochastic failures because independent replication makes simultaneous random failure vanishingly improbable; heterogeneity mitigates systemic failures because diverse implementations avoid common-mode triggers), the proposed dependence is an asserted correspondence, not a mechanistic relation. The 'refuted if' condition merely restates the correspondence in contrapositive and does not supply the missing causal link.
